page_title: PAR 0-1 GEN | Parma v Genoa 04/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Marco Guida has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+3' Adrian Benedyczak (Parma) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
90+2' Botond Balogh (Parma) finds himself some space around the penalty spot to connect with a fine free kick. His header is slightly mistimed and sails inches past the right post.
90+2' Marco Guida shows a yellow card to Mario Balotelli (Genoa), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
90+1' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Marco Guida blows his whistle for an infringement.
89' Mario Balotelli (Genoa) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
88' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
86' Alberto Gilardino decides to make a substitution. Milan Badelj will be replaced by Patrizio Masini (Genoa).
86' Mario Balotelli (Genoa) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jeff Ekhator.
84' Adrian Benedyczak (Parma) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
84' Parma work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
83' Dennis Man (Parma) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. The referee blows his whistle, Parma are awarded a corner kick.
83' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Parma, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
83' Substitution. Valentin Mihaila makes way for Adrian Benedyczak (Parma).
82' Caution goes to Johan Vasquez (Genoa).
79' 0 - 1 Goal! 0:1. Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) taps home from almost on the goal line after a lucky rebound fell at his feet.

79' That was a nice football moment. Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the bottom left corner. Zion Suzuki guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save!
78' Fine attempt! Pontus Almqvist (Parma) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post.
76' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
74' Alberto Gilardino prepares a substitution. Aaron Martin is replaced by Honest Ahanor (Genoa).
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) comes onto the pitch for Alessandro Zanoli.
73' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Genoa players look gutted.
73' That looked like an offside in the build-up play and the referee Marco Guida is going to take a look using VAR.
72' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
71' A quickly taken corner by Parma.

71' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) passes the ball onto Valentin Mihaila, but one of the defenders dispossesses him. The ball goes behind for a corner. Parma will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
67' Gabriel Charpentier (Parma) pounces on the cross into the centre of the box, but hangs his head in shame after sending his header well wide of the left post when the keeper was on his backside.
64' It's time for a substitution. Gabriel Charpentier (Parma) comes on in place of Ange-Yoan Bonny.
60' A yellow card for a tackle by Jeff Ekhator (Genoa). Marco Guida doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
60' Marco Guida couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Morten Thorsby (Genoa) and blew his whistle.
58' A short pass finds Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar.
58' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.

58' What a great touch by Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa)! He picks up a precise pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot on goal. His effort, however, only rattles the right post. What an unlucky moment for him.
58' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
54' Alessandro Zanoli (Genoa) sees a yellow card from Marco Guida after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
53' Nahuel Estevez (Parma) collects a wonderful lead pass and creates some space to smash the ball goalwards from long range. His shot goes painfully close to the right post!
50' Milan Badelj (Genoa) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
49' Goal, no wait. Marco Guida blows his whistle for handball and Morten Thorsby (Genoa) can't celebrate. Disallowed goal.
48' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Genoa comes to nothing.

47' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the roof of the net is denied by a decent save from Zion Suzuki. The ball goes out of play and Genoa have been awarded a corner kick.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Fabio Pecchia gives a chance to Pontus Almqvist and Mandela Keita (Parma) is off.
46' The game is over for Anas Haj Mohamed (Parma). Nahuel Estevez comes on for the second half.
46' The whistle blows and Marco Guida starts the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the top right corner, but Zion Suzuki has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
45+1' A corner kick by Genoa is thwarted by the well prepared Zion Suzuki (Parma).

45+1' Alessandro Zanoli (Genoa) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Genoa will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' A dangerous towering header by Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the left post. This corner kick didn't change the score.
44' Aaron Martin (Genoa) prepares to take a corner kick.
41' Today's referee Marco Guida rightly decides to book Anas Haj Mohamed (Parma) for his harsh tackle.
40' Valentin Mihaila (Parma) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
38' Aaron Martin (Genoa) attempts to score from a mid-range free kick, but he curls his effort a few inches over the crossbar.

37' Mandela Keita (Parma) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Marco Guida stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Genoa have been awarded a free kick.
36' The foul by Mandela Keita (Parma) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Marco Guida.
35' Dangerous play by Dennis Man (Parma). Marco Guida blows his whistle for a foul.
35' A dangerous looking corner kick from Aaron Martin (Genoa) is cleared to safety by the defence.
35' Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Corner kick. Genoa will have an opportunity.
32' A pass from Woyo Coulibaly (Parma) is intercepted by Nicola Leali and the move breaks down.
28' A sweet pass inside the box gives Valentin Mihaila (Parma) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance!
27' Parma have been awarded an indirect free kick.
27' That will be a yellow card for one of the players. The one who gets booked is Nicola Leali (Genoa).
26' Dennis Man (Parma) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
23' Anas Haj Mohamed (Parma) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post.
22' Anas Haj Mohamed (Parma) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
20' Aaron Martin (Genoa) takes the corner with a short pass.
17' Adrian Bernabe Garcia is being substituted because of an injury. Fabio Pecchia sends Anas Haj Mohamed (Parma) on the pitch.
16' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
15' Alan Matturro (Genoa) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
12' A lofted cross from Alessandro Vogliacco (Genoa) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
10' Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
6' Aaron Martin (Genoa) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
6' Genoa seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
4' Simon Sohm (Parma) latches on to a superb cross into the box and plants a header well wide of the right post.
3' Genoa take a short corner kick.

3' Dennis Man (Parma) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The linesman makes the right call and Parma will have a corner.
3' Alessandro Vogliacco (Genoa) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.

1' Alessandro Vogliacco (Genoa) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Zion Suzuki. This effort really didn't trouble him.
1' The match has just started.
Genoa will kick the game off.
Marco Guida was nominated as the referee for this game.
